notes.title: Supersedes 1.1.12 with the reviewed management-interface and package security batches; 1.1.12 is not withdrawn.
Account changes revoke earlier WebUI sessions; routing, recovery and configuration state are protected; request and privilege checks are enforced.
HTTPS alias feeds verify certificates and keep the last complete data on failure; DNS custom configuration requires separate privileges.
BIND, TFTP, Tailscale, Web Gateway and syslog-ng validation is hardened; NUT, HAProxy and Suricata widget request checks are included.
Require Expat 2.10.0, phpseclib 2.0.56 and Suricata 8.0.8 or later; verify actual installed versions after the update.
PPPoE uses the saved RADIUS NAS IP and accounting interval; the kernel-memory status panel handles FreeBSD 16 output.
FreeBSD base and ports move to the active pinned snapshot (OSVERSION 1600031); retain amd64 and generic arm64 installer coverage.
Before updating: export a config backup, keep console access, and review private-CA alias feeds, DNS delegation and stricter saved-value validation.
